# Third-Party Licenses

Generated by `cargo xtask licenses` from `cargo metadata` for `x86_64-pc-windows-msvc`.
Do not edit by hand; `cargo xtask licenses --check` fails when this file is stale.

Policy: every crate must satisfy its SPDX expression using only permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, MPL-2.0, ISC, Zlib, BSL-1.0, Unicode, CC0, Unlicense). Any GPL, LGPL or AGPL-only crate fails the audit. Every crate must also ship a licence text in its source, reproduced below.

"Scope" is `shipped` for crates in the dependency graph of the DLL or executables (including compile-time build-script and proc-macro crates), `tooling` for crates used only by repository automation (`xtask`).
